label: Salt formation 10ns: guidance of first-half fraction vs second-half fraction of the history
series: K2 (what the guidance is, not where it is)

conditions_definition.base: K15 conditions: train 58 proteins (DocD 4 + K15 additions 54), test 30 proteins (DocD 2 + K15 additions 28) pooled, origin frame 10 (1 ns), history frames 0-10 (100 ps spacing), HistGBM (120 iters, lr 0.075, 31 leaves, min_samples_leaf 15, L2 0.02, seed 42) refit per condition, 5 static features. Salt formation, k15_cache.
conditions_definition.fraction: fraction of frames with pair charged heavy-atom min distance <= 4.0 A (salt-bridge threshold; same definition as the '4.0 A below' statistic in the 6 statistics) within the given frame range, divided by the number of frames in that range (first/second half: 5, full: 11)

first_half.feature: fraction of frames [0..4] with distance <= 4.0 A

second_half.feature: fraction of frames [6..10] with distance <= 4.0 A

conditions_definition.note: Frame 5 (0.5 ns) belongs to neither half by design.
conditions_definition.both_halves_frac: static + first-half fraction and second-half fraction (2 features)
conditions_definition.full_frac: static + fraction over frames [0..10] (no prior 1ns salt-formation value)
conditions_definition.base_hist_D6: static + 6 statistics of the full 11-frame history (all-in reference)

base_reproduction.note: Base reproduction is checked against K15/K2-44 (10ns). There is no prior full-fraction 10ns salt-formation value.

reading_rule_fixed_in_advance.rule: second-half ratio (vs full6 gain) >= 0.8 and first-half ratio <= 0.5 -> 'current state carries it'; both ratios >= 0.8 -> 'persistent state carries it'; otherwise record the numbers as they are.
reading_rule_fixed_in_advance.verdict: どちらでもない（数値をそのまま記録）

per_protein_shapes_correction: Corrected 2026-11-24: the original counting excluded a protein only when |full gain| <= 0.01, so proteins with a large negative full gain were classified by ratios against a negative denominator (all 9 were counted as 'other'). The corrected counting (K2-145's rule) defines the ratio only when full gain > 0.01 and counts proteins with full gain < -0.01 separately as negative_full_gain. Original: now_state 1, continuing 0, other 22, excluded_gain_le_0.01 2, undefined_auprc 5. Pooled verdict unchanged.
